goal: Add rate limiting to the public API, reviewed by the other model family
label: ratelimit
context: The API sits behind a shared gateway, so per-process limits would not hold.
decisions: Token bucket, not a fixed window - bursts are expected and acceptable.
Limits belong in config, not hard-coded.
No new dependencies; standard library only.

tasks.prompt: List every route registered under /api/public. For each: file:line, HTTP method, and any middleware already applied. Output a markdown table. Do not modify anything.
Implement token-bucket rate limiting as middleware and apply it to every route in the table above. Match the existing middleware style in this repo. Add unit tests covering the refill boundary.

Adversarially review the change described above. Assume it contains at least one real bug. Check: wall-clock vs monotonic time, refill arithmetic and capacity overflow, lock coverage of read-modify-write, and unvalidated inputs. Report findings as a numbered list, each with file:line and a concrete failure scenario. If something is correct, say so rather than inventing a finding. Do not edit any file.
